name: [📘] Build and Survive the Forest!
desc:
Survive the Forest, Build Your Camp! 🌲🔥

Gather wood during the day and build fast because when night falls, the forest attacks. If your campfire goes out, it’s game over.

[How to Play]
• 🌳 Break trees to collect wood
• 🛠️ Turn wood into blocks using the wood machine
• 🔥 Build defenses to protect your fire
• ⚒️ Keep surviving and upgrading each day

Also... feel free to flex your nights when you join a server. LOL 😎
